content.short: Fasset is a stablecoin-powered Islamic neobank and digital asset platform for MENA and emerging markets.
content.description: Fasset is a stablecoin-powered digital bank built for emerging markets and one of the first Islamic, fully on-chain neobanks. Serving users across the MENA region, Southeast Asia and other emerging economies, it lets people hold dollar-pegged stablecoins such as USDC, make cross-border payments and invest in tokenized and digital assets from a single app. Fasset uses stablecoins as its settlement layer, running on its Own Network Layer 2 alongside established chains like Ethereum and Polygon to keep transactions fast and low cost. Backed by a 51 million dollar raise, it works to turn stablecoins into everyday banking rails for people underserved by traditional banks.
